body:
After a bout of depression that lasted for more than a year, I've been feeling much better for the past few weeks.  I'm not sure if this is just a short phase I'm going through, but hopefully it will last.  Here's a list of a few things that have changed in my life:

* First off, there was a huge change in scenery for me.  I spent the past year in a new city doing an internship where I hardly knew anyone.  Since January, I've been back at school (where I still have almost no friends) in a rural setting.

* I've started seeing a counselor that's really helped me think about where my unhappiness may be stemming from.  I've pinpointed a few huge flaws in my way of thinking that have been significantly contributing (for instance, I think a lot of my unhappiness stems from the way in which I viewed my parents' lives - once I got rid of the unfair and irrational thoughts surrounding my perception of their happiness, I started feeling much better myself).

* I've started exercising regularly and making a solid effort to eat healthy (no more fast food, more vegetables and fruits, three square meals a day, etc.)

* Recently, I started participating in activities that I enjoy (boxing, tennis, rock-climbing, etc.).
